text_block_list.text:
Autumn had fully deepened,
and one day, with the chill of winter just around the corner—
Katsuragi Ace and I had come to watch a certain debut race.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —The final straight, and Mr. C.B. is still in the lead!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Across the line!!
An undisputed, magnificent victory—!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—She's not just as good as the rumors say, she's better.
Didn't she win by around five lengths at the end?
Man, what an incredible Umamusume has appeared...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be... could she actually become
a Triple Crown Umamusume?!
I definitely can't take my eyes off her now~!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Haha. Getting this much attention right from her debut race—that's CB for you. And besides—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —She really is... strong...!
choice_data_list: Ace is steadily building up her skills, too.

text_block_list.text:
Even though he remains in Mr. C.B.'s shadow right now,
I can genuinely feel that Katsuragi Ace is steadily building strength
for the leap to come...!
choice_data_list: Next year, let's show everyone just how strong you are!
Next year, let's show everyone just how strong you are!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh! Thanks, Trainer!!
Alright, let's go do this!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: All right! Give me your harshest, strictest training after this too!!

And then, a few days after
Mr. C.B.'s sensational debut race—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... all right...!
I'm way more stable on the corners now...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'll do one more lap to make sure of the feel.
Trainer will surely be surprised—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
Isn't that over there—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: —Well, you know. It ended up a bit different from what we'd imagined, huh?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: —...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Yo, you two!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Ess-chi~!
Self-training today as always~? What a goody-two-shoes~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha, super serious, right~?
There's never enough time to spare, after all!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: What's with those two? Did they forget something?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Ah, umm...—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: ...They were listening to what I had to say.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I suffered that terrible loss in my debut race...
I've been feeling so, so anxious—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Even when training, I feel so uneasy... and races
have started to feel a bit scary...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: Watching amazing Umamusume like CB-chan... seeing them shine so brilliantly... honestly, it was painful—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
"...I know how you feel.
My debut race was decent too, but in the next race I ended up second to last--"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
TBH... it's really, really rough.
It makes me feel like 'maybe it'll be like this forever'....

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
“Still... as long as we're together, we'll figure it out someday.
...Even if we don't win the next race—”

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Even if we keep losing... things will work out someday.
—You think so too, right, S-chi?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Ah, damn it...
Their eyes, that atmosphere... it feels so familiar—)

text_block_list.name: Local Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
......It was never going to be a real contest.
That place is just a completely "different world" from us.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Her words might be positive, but... it's the same—
Deep down... those are the eyes of someone who's given up—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(I can tell...
Because we've fought together for so, so long.
Because both of them have always been by my side—)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(“Someday,” or “even if I lose”...!
That kind of thinking won't cut it...!!)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: ...Es-cchi?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: …………Hey, um.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...Why don't you put the last race behind you for now
and just give it your all?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: We're just getting started anyway. For now, let's just... keep moving forward!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: Both of you...—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
"...Right, you're right.
I'll... try a little harder."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: Mm-hmm, let's do our best together.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
……You knew this would happen.
Not everyone can win.
Not everyone gets what they desire……!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Even though I knew... for the two of them to be like that...—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Snap out of it!
Switch gears, switch gears!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(I'm the one who has to fight reality!
I'm the only one who can change things...!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(All I can do is move forward!
Believing that the two of them will seize what they desire, I'll walk my own path...!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Give it all you've got, both of you...!!
I'm not gonna lose either...!!!

Dazzling, glittering stars. Faintly glowing stars.
The sky embraces them all equally as time marches on—
